name: treasury-swap-guard
description: DAO and team treasury swaps on SaucerSwap V2 (Hedera testnet) with an on-chain policy guard, roles, pause and HCS receipts

create-scaffold-hbar.outro: UI mode needs no deploy: fund a Hedera testnet wallet, run yarn next:dev, associate SAUCE and swap. Treasury mode: yarn hardhat:deploy --network hederaTestnet --tags TreasuryPolicyGuard, fund the printed address and set NEXT_PUBLIC_TREASURY_GUARD_ADDRESS.
